capabilities: Transcribe embedded images to Markdown notes
Generate image descriptions in Describe mode
Stream results live into a sidebar
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ for keychain-stored API keys. HEIC/HEIF images are recognized but skipped. Fully offline with no telemetry. Sister plugin: vault-rag.
motivation: Split out of vault-rag because image transcription is not RAG; the two only ever shared the SSE transport.
problem: Obsidian cannot extract text from images or PDFs on its own, leaving scans, screenshots and photographed pages unsearchable.

relations.evidence: Image to Markdown was split out of vault-rag 0.2.0 on 2026-06-21 because image transcription is not RAG
If the LLM Endpoint Manager plugin is installed, the endpoints (and their keys) come from it instead
an OpenAI-compatible local server running a vision-capable model (e.g. LM Studio)

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible local vision server (e.g. LM Studio)
endpoint API key for hosted providers

summary: Vision-LLM tool that transcribes embedded images and PDFs in a note into Markdown notes, fully offline and non-destructive.
